title: handles are TOO long.
text: handles are TOO long.. What is up with the super long handles??  I dont love this feature.  It was hard to store and whilst I have hanging beam - they are too long.  I got them [they are not free] to minimize using utensils with plastic in my cooking - whilst this fulfills my needs - the freaking long handles.  That aside, easy to clean and can throw into dish washer - will take up more space.  good selection - love the pasta and the two flat 'spoons'.
